meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. De Silva

rules.statement: A way of necessity cannot be claimed beyond the actual necessity of the case, and even if a cartway is considered necessary, it may have been lost by prescription due to lack of action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Roman-Dutch law a way of necessity cannot be claimed beyond the actual necessity of the case. Here there is no proof that a cartway is a necessity, as the plaintiffs are shown to have have been content during the last fifty years with carrying their produce on their shoulders along the footpath."
